scope: Replace fourteen Wasmtime setup sites in twelve workflows with the identical official 42.0.1 archive and checksum. Confine strict shell flags and cleanup to a subshell, remove eleven unused Nix installer steps and preserve all original routes, budgets, acceptance, artifact and enforcement commands. Make three owned-subtype tool-discovery failures propagate correctly. Retain the six offline installer scenarios, 84 altered/duplicate installer controls, 254 workflow bypass controls and 117 gate outcomes. Refresh exactly 214 live CI/documentation source pins and update two setup descriptions, without modifying runtime code, support observations or older evidence. The rollout has source validation only; require actual installed acceptance, independent original artifact replay and final Core/hosted gates.

edits.previous:
- name: Install the documented Nix CLI
        if: matrix.lane == 'wit-wasi'
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
        with:
          install_url: https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-2.24.11/install

edits.current:
run: |
          (
            set -euo pipefail
            test "$(uname -sm)" = 'Linux x86_64'
            mkdir -p build
            test ! -e build/wasmtime-c-api && test ! -L build/wasmtime-c-api
            WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING=$(mktemp -d build/wasmtime-c-api.XXXXXX)
            trap 'rm -rf -- "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING"' EXIT
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 \
              --output "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/wasmtime.tar.xz" \
              'https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/releases/download/v42.0.1/wasmtime-v42.0.1-x86_64-linux-c-api.tar.xz'
            echo '2097a47351918a446b26c7e65f487278f63bc947591b71897db547cd90c05082'"  $WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/wasmtime.tar.xz" | sha256sum --check --status
            mkdir "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked"
            tar -xJf "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/wasmtime.tar.xz" --strip-components=1 -C "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/include/wasmtime.h"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/include/wasm.h"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/lib/libwasmtime.so"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/lib/libwasmtime.a"
            mv -T "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked" build/wasmtime-c-api
          )
